summary_en: This phase II study tests cabozantinib together with pembrolizumab in adults with adrenocortical carcinoma that is locally advanced, metastatic, or cannot be removed by surgery. Cabozantinib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 21 of each 21-day cycle, and pembrolizumab is given through a vein on day 1 of each cycle; cycles repeat without disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome is not stated; this is a phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa cabozantinib combinado con pembrolizumab en adultos con carcinoma adrenocortical localmente avanzado, metastásico o que no puede extirparse con cirugía. Cabozantinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo; los ciclos se repiten mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; se trata de un estudio de fase II.
who_for: ECOG performance status 2 or lower, or Karnofsky 50% or higher.
Metastatic or unresectable locally advanced adrenal cortical carcinoma, confirmed by tissue.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks and blood, liver and kidney test values within set limits.
not_for: Prior immune checkpoint blockade, such as anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 or anti-CTLA-4 antibodies, or CD137 agonists.
Small molecule kinase inhibitor use within 2 weeks before first dose.
Current use of mitotane, with stopping rules stated.
Known brain metastases or cranial epidural disease that is not adequately treated and stable.
Certain blood thinners, such as warfarin, dabigatran or clopidogrel, with some exceptions stated.
